## AI Overview

When an LLM generates long text, it stores keys and values from earlier tokens so it need not recompute them. This store is the KV cache, and it grows with sequence length and batch size. Offloading the cache from GPU to larger CPU memory helps fit the workload. However, fetching it back over the CPU–GPU connection can become a major inference cost.
